HPX_SHORTCUTS.py.summary: The HpxShortcuts class is a comprehensive Page Object Model implementation for testing HP Smart app's shortcuts functionality on Android. It extends SmartFlow and provides extensive automation capabilities for creating, editing, configuring, and managing shortcuts with multiple destinations (print, email, save). The class demonstrates advanced test automation patterns including: dynamic locator construction using f-strings for parameterized elements (e.g., color cards by index, dropdown items by value), consistent wait-for-element patterns with configurable timeouts and exception handling, attribute verification methods for checking element states (enabled, selected), comprehensive workflow coverage from shortcut creation through execution and deletion, integration with external services (Google Drive authentication), and extensive validation methods for UI elements and screen transitions. The implementation follows a clear naming convention with methods prefixed by action type (verify_, click_, enter_, select_) and includes detailed docstrings. Notable features include support for Quick Run shortcuts, color card selection for visual customization, file type selection (image/PDF), print settings configuration (copies, color, two-sided), email configuration with validation, and account management. The class uses the Selenium WebDriver pattern through self.driver for all element interactions and includes swipe gestures for scrolling to elements.
